audit_chain_shape.name: audit_chain_shape
audit_chain_shape.value: ("audit_log"."hash" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."prev_hash" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."chain_seq" IS NULL) OR ("audit_log"."hash" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."prev_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."chain_seq" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "audit_log"."prev_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "audit_log"."chain_seq" > 0)

tax_rates.name: tax_rates
tax_rates.value: "tax_rule"."vat_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "tax_rule"."nhil_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "tax_rule"."getfund_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "tax_rule"."covid_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
